# Q1. What type of data is it? Describe it

```{r}
vect2sql <- function(x){
  paste("('", paste(x, collapse = "','"), "')", 
                 sep = "")
}
gse_ids <- c("GSE201427","GSE166530","GSE162183","GSE186458")
gse_sql <- vect2sql(gse_ids)
# dbListTables(con)

# dbListFields(con, 'gpl')

sql <- paste(
  "SELECT DISTINCT gse_gpl.gse, gse_gpl.gpl, gse.title",
  "FROM gse JOIN gse_gpl ON gse_gpl.gse = gse.gse",
  "WHERE gse.gse IN", gse_sql, sep = " ")
series <- dbGetQuery(con, sql)
```

GSE186458, GSE166530, GSE162183: Illumina NovaSeq 6000 (Homo sapiens), high-throughput sequencing (RNA-seq)

GSE201427: Illumina HiSeq 4000 (Homo sapiens), high-throughput sequencing (RNA-seq)
